description: See an artboard: the rendered PNG plus measured facts about it: text overflowing its box, text overlapping other text or covered by a shape drawn above it, shapes past the frame (and how far), text contrast below WCAG AA with the ratio, fonts that fell back, and text under 11 px on a phone artboard. Facts are measurements, not a verdict: you decide what to fix. region {x, y, width, height} (artboard-local) crops a detail at up to 8x; scale sets the zoom. Without artboard, the active one. artboards:[refs] or flow:true returns one readable contact sheet and per-artboard facts. before_after:true compares with the previous look of this same view. Inspect the whole flow, choose its most valuable improvement and decide whether to revise; no round quota or score. critique:true optionally adds a separate advisory review; pass a one-paragraph brief, remembered per project.

brief.description: One paragraph for the optional reviewer; retained for this project.

region.description: Crop this rectangle, artboard-local (0,0 is the artboard's top-left).

scale.description: Zoom, up to 4 (8 with region). Omit to let the preview pick.

name: look
title: Look at an artboard
